verdicts.why: Faithful to the page (several children, scored, pruned, backtracking native) and its counts are right; the one defect is that the top dead-end node is drawn on top of the subtitle "several continuations, scored, and the weak ones dropped". Move the tree down about 20 px. Notes: it is the standard schematic, close to the paper's own Figure 1, so nothing out of the ordinary; the node whose two children both died is left unmarked. The honest line is true. Caption states a claim. At 440 px the shapes read.
